FX-CURL-001.says: The settings as they start: size 100, so across the 16 by 10 card the noise is one soft cloud, swirling slowly; every shown pixel is a grey, the empty pixels stay empty and the soft edge keeps its half covering.

FX-CURL-002.says: Size 6, sample radius 4, 6 samples: grey flow lines through cells of 6 pixels.

FX-CURL-003.says: View Input Noise: the smooth noise the flow follows, without its lines.

FX-CURL-004.says: View Curl Generation: red is the flow across, green the flow down, blue the noise.

FX-CURL-005.says: Sample Radius 0: no lines, so the frame is FX-CURL-003's Input Noise.

FX-CURL-006.says: Flow Softness 100: the lines softened away, FX-CURL-003's Input Noise again.

FX-CURL-007.says: Swirl 0, Curl Generation: the flow is the noise's curl, crossing its slope at a right angle.

FX-CURL-008.says: Swirl 180, Curl Generation: the flow turns with the noise, unlike FX-CURL-007's.

FX-CURL-009.says: Vertical Bias 100, Curl Generation: the flow only runs up and down, so red is the middle grey throughout.

FX-CURL-010.says: Vertical Bias 0, Curl Generation: the flow only runs across, so green is the middle grey throughout.

FX-CURL-011.says: Speed 20, Direction 90, Turbulence Speed 0, Input Noise: the noise drifts 2 pixels right a frame, so frame 1 is frame 0 moved 2 right.

FX-CURL-012.says: Offset 3 right, still, Input Noise: the noise moved 3 pixels right.

FX-CURL-013.says: Turbulence Speed 100, Speed 0: the noise changes from frame to frame in place.

FX-CURL-014.says: Evolution 90, still: a different noise from FX-CURL-002's.

FX-CURL-015.says: Density 50: the field's cells half the size, so it is size 3 at density 0, FX-CURL-016.

FX-CURL-017.says: Smoothness 0, still, Input Noise: the fine octaves stronger.

FX-CURL-018.says: Smoothness 100, still, Input Noise: the fine octaves weaker.

FX-CURL-019.says: Edge Definition 100, still: the lines streak blocky seeds.

FX-CURL-020.says: Edge Definition 0, still: the lines streak smooth seeds.

FX-CURL-021.says: Flow Falloff 100, still: the lines fade where the noise is low.

FX-CURL-022.says: Contrast 300, Brightness 10, still: harder greys, held in 0 and 1.

FX-CURL-023.says: Contrast 300, Brightness 10, Clip HDR Results off, in a composition that does not work in Float: still held at 1, so the frame is FX-CURL-022's.

FX-CURL-024.says: Contrast 300, Brightness 10, Clip HDR Results off, in a Float composition: past white is kept.

FX-CURL-025.says: Channel Red, still: only red is replaced; green and blue are the drawing's.

FX-CURL-026.says: Channel Alpha, still: the covering times the grey, the colour kept.

FX-CURL-027.says: Sample Count 3.9, still: its whole part counts, so this is sample count 3, FX-CURL-028.

FX-CURL-029.says: Sample Radius keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4, still: frame 0 is the Input Noise, frame 4 long lines.

FX-CURL-030.says: FX-CURL-002 moved three pixels right: the noise is the drawing's own, so it moves with it.

FX-CURL-031.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the noise is worked in the drawing's own pixels, so the frame is FX-CURL-002's.

FX-CURL-032.says: Swirl -200, Speed 35, Direction 200, Evolution 45, Turbulence Speed 60, Density -30, Smoothness 20, Vertical Bias 70, 9 samples, radius 6.5, Flow Softness 10, Edge Definition 30, Falloff 40, Contrast 150, Brightness -5, Channel Green: the controls together.
